summary: Upstream bank settlement timeout during batch reconciliation.
resolution: Increase settlement_timeout_ms to 15000 in payment-gateway config and trigger manual replay via `acme-cli replay --batch-id`.

summary: Token introspection endpoint throttled due to missing Redis cache.
resolution: Verify Redis cluster health and enable `TOKEN_CACHE_TTL=300` in auth-service.

summary: TLS handshake failure when delivering webhooks to legacy customer endpoints.
resolution: Enable `ALLOW_TLS_1_2=true` for the specific tenant ID in the webhook-dispatcher tenant overrides.
